description: Defines the SupplierQuotationController class for handling supplier quotation forms in ERPNext, including setup, refresh, and related actions such as creating purchase orders, quotations, and linking to material requests.

classes.name: SupplierQuotationController
classes.description: Controller class for supplier quotation form, extending erpnext.buying.BuyingController, managing setup, refresh, and actions related to supplier quotations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes custom buttons for the supplier quotation form.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates form UI based on document state, including setting default valid_till date and adding custom buttons for creating purchase orders, quotations, and linking material requests.

methods.name: make_purchase_order
methods.description: Creates a new purchase order mapped from the current supplier quotation.

methods.name: make_quotation
methods.description: Creates a new quotation mapped from the current supplier quotation.
